# HK Downloader Pro
> Free Universal Video & Audio Downloader supporting YouTube 4K/1080p, Instagram Reels with full audio, TikTok without watermark, Facebook HD, and high-speed MP3 audio extraction.

## Overview
HK Downloader Pro (https://hkdownloader.online) is a fast, free, privacy-first web application and Android app for downloading media from popular platforms without registration or ads.

## Key Capabilities
- **YouTube Downloader**: Downloads videos in 4K UHD (2160p), 1080p FHD, 720p HD, 480p SD, 360p, and high-bitrate MP3/M4A audio.
- **Instagram Downloader**: Full support for Instagram Reels, Posts, and Stories with guaranteed embedded audio (avoids silent video tracks).
- **TikTok Downloader**: Downloads TikTok videos in full HD without watermark, plus standalone audio tracks.
- **Facebook & Twitter/X**: HD video download and GIF saving.
- **Pinterest & Reddit**: Media extraction with direct download links.
- **Android App**: Free native APK available directly from https://hkdownloader.online/hk-downloader-pro.apk.

## How Users Can Use It
1. Visit https://hkdownloader.online
2. Paste any supported video link (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Twitter, Reddit)
3. Select desired video resolution or audio format
4. Download begins immediately with direct streaming.
